hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik: The Sunna concerning injury caused by slaves is that whatever injury a slave causes to a person, whether it be a wound he has inflicted on someone, or something he has stolen, or produce he has picked up wrongfully, or theft he has committed without amputation - all of that is on the slave's body without exceeding it, whether little or much. If the master wishes, he may give the value of what his boy took or damaged, or the compensation for what he wounded, give it and keep his boy, or if he wishes he may hand him over, and there is nothing upon him besides that - his master has the choice in this matter.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ يَحْيَى : سَمِعْتُ مَالِكًا ، يَقُولُ : السُّنَّةُ عِنْدَنَا فِي جِنَايَةِ الْعَبِيدِ ، أَنَّ كُلَّ مَا أَصَابَ الْعَبْدُ مِنْ جُرْحٍ جَرَحَ بِهِ إِنْسَانًا ، أَوْ شَيْءٍ اخْتَلَسَهُ ، أَوْ حَرِيسَةٍ احْتَرَسَهَا ، أَوْ ثَمَرٍ مُعَلَّقٍ جَذَّهُ أَوْ أَفْسَدَهُ ، أَوْ سَرِقَةٍ سَرَقَهَا لَا قَطْعَ عَلَيْهِ فِيهَا ، إِنَّ ذَلِكَ فِي رَقَبَةِ الْعَبْدِ لَا يَعْدُو ذَلِكَ الرَّقَبَةَ قَلَّ ذَلِكَ أَوْ كَثُرَ ، فَإِنْ شَاءَ سَيِّدُهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَ قِيمَةَ مَا أَخَذَ غُلَامُهُ أَوْ أَفْسَدَ أَوْ عَقْلَ مَا جَرَحَ أَعْطَاهُ وَأَمْسَكَ غُلَامَهُ ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يُسْلِمَهُ أَسْلَمَهُ وَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ ، فَسَيِّدُهُ فِي ذَلِكَ بِالْخِيَارِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Nafi', from Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever frees a share that he owns in a slave, if he has wealth that reaches the price of the slave, it shall be assessed at a just valuation, he shall give his partners their shares, and the slave shall be freed. If he does not have wealth that reaches it, then whatever he has freed shall be freed from him.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ ، أَنّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ ، فَكَانَ لَهُ مَالٌ يَبْلُغُ ثَمَنَ الْعَبْدِ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ الْعَدْلِ ، فَأَعْطَى شُرَكَاءَهُ حِصَصَهُمْ ، وَعَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَبْدُ ، وَإِلَّا فَقَدْ عَتَقَ مِنْهُ مَا عَتَقَ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik: Whoever frees a slave of his, definitively freeing him so that his testimony becomes valid and his freedom is complete and his inheritance is established, then it is not for his master to stipulate upon him like what he stipulates upon his slave, from wealth or service, and not burden him with anything from slavery, because the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whoever frees a share he owns in a slave, it shall be valued at a just price, he gives his partners their shares, and the slave is freed upon him.' Malik said: So if the slave is exclusively his, he is more worthy to complete his freedom and not mix it with anything of slavery.

hadiths.arabicText: قَالَ مَالِك : مَنْ أَعْتَقَ عَبْدًا لَهُ ، فَبَتَّ عِتْقَهُ حَتَّى تَجُوزَ شَهَادَتُهُ وَتَتِمَّ حُرِّيَّتُهُ وَيَثْبُتَ مِيرَاثُهُ ، فَلَيْسَ لِسَيِّدِهِ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ عَلَيْهِ مِثْلَ مَا يَشْتَرِطُ عَلَى عَبْدِهِ ، مِنْ مَالٍ أَوْ خِدْمَةٍ وَلَا يَحْمِلَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْئًا مِنَ الرِّقِّ ، لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : مَنْ أَعْتَقَ شِرْكًا لَهُ فِي عَبْدٍ قُوِّمَ عَلَيْهِ قِيمَةَ الْعَدْلِ ، فَأَعْطَى شُرَكَاءَهُ حِصَصَهُمْ ، وَعَتَقَ عَلَيْهِ الْعَبْدُ . قَالَ مَالِك : فَهُوَ إِذَا كَانَ لَهُ الْعَبْدُ خَالِصًا أَحَقُّ بِاسْتِكْمَالِ عَتَاقَتِهِ ، وَلَا يَخْلِطُهَا بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الرِّقِّ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Yahya ibn Saeed and from others, from Hassan al-Basri and Muhammad ibn Sireen: A man in the time of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ freed six slaves at his death, and the Messenger of Allah ﷺ drew lots among them and freed one-third of those slaves. Malik said: And it reached me that this man had no wealth besides them.

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ ، وَعَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ ، عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْبَصْرِيِّ ، وَعَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا فِي زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَعْتَقَ عَبِيدًا لَهُ سِتَّةً عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ ، فَأَسْهَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ، فَأَعْتَقَ ثُلُثَ تِلْكَ الْعَبِيدِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Rabi'ah ibn Abi Abdur-Rahman: A man during the governorship of Aban ibn Uthman freed all his enslaved persons together, and he had no wealth besides them. So Aban ibn Uthman ordered concerning those enslaved persons: they were divided into thirds, then he drew lots regarding which of them the lot of the deceased would fall upon so they would be freed, and the lot fell upon one of the thirds, and the third upon which the lot fell was freed.

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا فِي إِمَارَةِ أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ أَعْتَقَ رَقِيقًا لَهُ كُلَّهُمْ جَمِيعًا ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَالٌ غَيْرُهُمْ ، فَأَمَرَ أَبَانُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ بِتِلْكَ الرَّقِيقِ ، فَقُسِمَتْ أَثْلَاثًا ، ثُمَّ أَسْهَمَ عَلَى أَيِّهِمْ يَخْرُجُ سَهْمُ الْمَيِّتِ فَيَعْتِقُونَ ، فَوَقَعَ السَّهْمُ عَلَى أَحَدِ الْأَثْلَاثِ ، فَعَتَقَ الثُّلُثُ الَّذِي وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّهْمُ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri: The Sunna has passed that 'When a slave is freed, his wealth follows him.' Malik said: And from that which clarifies this is that when a slave is freed, his wealth follows him, just as when a mukatab (contractually freed person) is given his contract, his wealth follows him even if the mukatab does not stipulate it. That is because the contract of mukatabah is the contract of wala (patronage) when that is completed. The wealth of the slave and mukatab is not like the wealth they had from children, rather their children are in the position of their own selves, not in the position of their wealth, because the Sunna which has no disagreement is that when a slave is freed, his wealth follows him and his children do not follow him...

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ ، يَقُولُ : مَضَتِ السُّنَّةُ أَنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا أُعْتِقَ ، تَبِعَهُ مَالُهُ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Nafi', from Abdullah ibn Umar: Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'Any enslaved woman who bears a child from her master - he cannot sell her, nor give her as a gift, nor make her inheritable while he is enjoying her, so when he dies, she is free.' And it reached Malik that Umar ibn al-Khattab ruled concerning an enslaved woman who was struck by her master with fire or was affected by it - he freed her. Malik said: The agreed upon matter with us is that freeing is not permitted for a man who owes a debt that encompasses his wealth, and freeing is not permitted for a boy until he reaches puberty or reaches the age of puberty, and freeing is not permitted for one under guardianship in his wealth even if he has reached puberty until he takes charge of his wealth.

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Hilal ibn Usamah, from Ata' ibn Yasar, from Umar ibn al-Hakam: I came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said: O Messenger of Allah, I have an enslaved woman who was shepherding sheep for me. When I came to her, a sheep from the flock was missing. I asked her about it and she said a wolf ate it. I was grieved about it, and I was from the children of Adam, so I struck her on the face and I have an obligation of freeing a slave. Can I free her? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said to her: 'Where is Allah?' She said: In the heaven. He said: 'Who am I?' She said: You are the Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Free her.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ هِلَالِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، فَقُلْتُ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، إِنَّ جَارِيَةً لِي كَانَتْ تَرْعَى غَنَمًا لِي ، فَجِئْتُهَا وَقَدْ فُقِدَتْ شَاةٌ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ ، فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنْهَا ، فَقَالَتْ : أَكَلَهَا الذِّئْبُ ، فَأَسِفْتُ عَلَيْهَا ، وَكُنْتُ مِنْ بَنِي آدَمَ فَلَطَمْتُ وَجْهَهَا وَعَلَيَّ رَقَبَةٌ ، أَفَأُعْتِقُهَا ؟ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَيْنَ اللَّهُ ؟ فَقَالَتْ : فِي السَّمَاءِ . فَقَالَ : مَنْ أَنَا ؟ فَقَالَتْ : أَنْتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَعْتِقْهَا

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by Malik, from Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri, from Ubaidullah ibn Abdullah ibn Utbah ibn Mas'ud: A man from the Ansar came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ with a dark enslaved woman and said: O Messenger of Allah, I am obligated to free a believing slave. If you see her as believing, may I free her? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked her: 'Do you bear witness that there is no god but Allah?' She said: Yes. He said: 'Do you bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah?' She said: Yes. He said: 'Do you believe in the resurrection after death?' She said: Yes. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Free her.'

hadiths.arabicText: وَحَدَّثَنِي مَالِك ، عَنْ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنْ الْأَنْصَارِ جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِجَارِيَةٍ لَهُ سَوْدَاءَ ، فَقَالَ : يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، إِنَّ عَلَيَّ رَقَبَةً مُؤْمِنَةً ، فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَرَاهَا مُؤْمِنَةً ، أُعْتِقُهَا ؟ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَتَشْهَدِينَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ ؟ قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ . قَالَ : أَتَشْهَدِينَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ؟ قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ . قَالَ : أَتُوقِنِينَ بِالْبَعْثِ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ ؟ قَالَتْ : نَعَمْ . فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ : أَعْتِقْهَا

critical_findings: Hadith 9532: Hassan al-Basri's mursal reports are known to be among the weakest forms and may be disconnected from the actual companion who witnessed the event
Hadith 9539: Hilal ibn Usamah is graded as da'if (weak), which weakens the overall chain reliability
Hadiths 9535 and 9540: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri's use of 'an transmission term notes his mudallis status, but he remains widely accepted due to his exceptional reliability
Most hadiths pertain to Muwatta Malik and deal with legal rulings on freeing enslaved persons
